title: Rust-owned Python language support
description: Use roadmap-sliced-development-pattern to add Python support to the Rust-owned indexing path and validate it on a suitably sized GitHub Python project.

decisions.q: 本目标是否使用专用分支和 roadmap-sliced-development-pattern？
decisions.answer: 采用。分支为 codex/rust-owned-python-support，过程状态写入 docs/plans/2026-07-02-rust-owned-python-support-roadmap.json/md。
decisions.note: 非平凡跨层语言支持，满足 pattern 的 branch、leaf gate、commit intent 和最终 closeout 要求。

decisions.q: Python 支持目标如何收敛？
decisions.answer: 不是重复注册 Python；当前主干已有 baseline Rust-owned Python。目标收敛为补齐 Python extractor 的实用语义覆盖，并用中等 GitHub Python 项目提供真实 corpus 验证。
decisions.note: 历史 docs/benchmarks/2026-06-24-current-state-decision-pack.md 仍标注 Python real-corpus evidence/open sufficiency boundary。

1-1.label: Rust-owned Python 支持范围与现状定位

decisions.q: 第一片的 gate 和 commit intent 是什么？
decisions.answer: Gate：定位 Rust-owned 当前语言注册、Python TS extractor 能力、缺口清单，并把下一步切片收敛到可实现范围。Commit intent：docs: add rust-owned python support roadmap.
decisions.note: 这是 decision-only/exploration leaf，完成条件是 roadmap 决策和现状证据落盘。

1-1.notes: Evidence: Rust core already has SourceLanguage::Python, tree-sitter-python, extract_python_symbols, and a rust-hybrid smoke test for Python-owned indexing. Durable gap from current-state decision pack: real Python corpus evidence and sufficiency boundary still missing. Dogfood zcodegraph index is currently malformed, so repo exploration used rg/file reads.

1-2.label: Rust extractor Python 语法与符号覆盖
1-2.notes: Gate passed. Implemented Rust-owned Python decorator refs for decorated functions/classes/methods and allowed same-file exact finalization to consider Python decorates refs. Verification: cargo test -p zcodegraph-core rust_index_emits_python_decorator_refs_for_local_decorators; cargo build -p zcodegraph-core; npm run build; npx vitest run __tests__/rust-index-engine-cli-language-smoke.test.ts -t 'indexes Python as Rust-owned under rust-hybrid'.

1-3.label: CLI 与 SQLite 合同验证
1-3.notes: Gate: verify the Rust-owned Python decorator contract through CLI/SQLite metadata and decide whether extra status/profile assertions are needed. Commit intent: test: cover rust-owned python decorator graph contract.
